articles.title: Breaking a Fundamental Rule of Physics: Scientists Create a Material That Makes Heat Programmable
articles.summary: A new device can control the direction of heat radiation, switch it on and off, and remember its state without power — like a thermal computer. It overcomes a long-standing physics principle called reciprocity, opening doors to smarter energy systems.

articles.title: OpenAI's Sam Altman Floats Plan to Give Every U.S. Household a $320 Stake in AI
articles.summary: Sam Altman is reportedly discussing giving the U.S. government a 5% stake in OpenAI, worth roughly $320 per American household. The proposal aims to address concerns about AI's impact on labor and creative compensation, while raising questions about wealth distribution in the AI era.

articles.title: How Ghostlike Particles Could Prevent Covert Nuclear Weapons Production in Fusion Reactors
articles.summary: Antineutrino detectors like MiniCHANDLER could remotely monitor fusion reactors for clandestine plutonium production, a new study shows. The technique exploits the unstoppable nature of neutrinos, offering a non-intrusive safeguard as fusion energy nears reality.
